subject: gk
question:
Which of the following new words were added to Indian Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act?

A. Socialist

B. Integrity

C. Fraternity

D. Secular

E. Equality
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act was enacted in 1976 during the Emergency in India.
 
• This amendment is also known as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its wide-ranging changes to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The words "Socialist", "Secular", and "Integrity" were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by this amendment.
 
• The Preamble serves as an introduction to the Constitution and reflects its fundamental values and guiding principles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Socialist:**

 
 
• The term "Socialist" means that wealth generated in the country should be shared equally among all citizens and that the state should make efforts to reduce inequalities in income, status, and standards of living.
 
 
 
• **Secular:**
 
 
• The term "Secular" means that the state has no official religion and treats all religions equally. It ensures religious freedom for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **Integrity:**
 
 
• Integrity refers to the unity and the sense of national solidarity among the citizens of India.
 
 
 
• **Preamble of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• The Preamble is a brief introductory statement that sets out the guiding purposes and principles of the Constitution.
 
• It reflects the vision and values of the Constitution makers and serves as a guiding light for its interpretation.
